title: Deep-learning decision support classifies gastric lesions and atrophy in endoscopy
summary: A deep-learning system built on 11,868 endoscopic images classified six lesion classes (advanced and early gastric cancer, dysplasia, atrophy, intestinal metaplasia, normal) with 90.3% internal accuracy and 85.3% overall accuracy on 1,282 external images. In 522 prospective screening endoscopies, accuracy was 92.1% for atrophy and 95.5% for intestinal metaplasia, with no significant difference from endoscopists (P = .23). Korean centres only, and prospective results are given per class.
ai_technology: Deep-learning clinical decision support system: six-class lesion classifier and atrophy/intestinal-metaplasia segmentation

evidence.tested: External test on 1,282 images from another institution and prospective evaluation in 522 consecutive endoscopies with blinded endoscopist comparison.
evidence.unknown: Effect on patient outcomes; performance outside Korean centres; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning models classified gastric lesions and segmented preneoplastic conditions in endoscopy.
